faq.title: Good to know.
faq.sub: Quick answers for customers and salon owners.

items.a: Yes. Searching, comparing and opening salon pages is free, with no login and no app to install.

items.q: How do I find a salon near me?
items.a: Type your city, area or a salon name in the search, or tap Near me to sort salons by distance from where you are.
Prices show where a service starts, as shared by the salon. The final price can depend on hair length, products and the stylist, so confirm at the salon.

items.q: How do I list my salon?
items.a: Send “Hi” to TrimCircle on WhatsApp with your photos, prices and timings. We set up your free page and you can change it later by sending another message.

items.q: Does it cost anything for salon owners?
items.a: No. A salon page on TrimCircle is free. Help with your Google Business Profile is free too.

items.q: Can I use TrimCircle in Hindi?
items.a: Yes. Switch to हिन्दी from the language menu at the top. More Indian languages are on the way.
